title: AgileMD to join Wolters Kluwer, bringing AI-powered clinical pathways and deterioration detection to clinicians worldwide
summary: San Francisco, November 13, 2026 – AgileMD, Inc., an AI-powered clinical decision support company, announced today that it has entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by Wolters Kluwer, a global leader in professional information solutions, software and services based in the Netherlands, and the provider of UpToDate. The transaction is subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals.
body_markdown:
San Francisco, November 13, 2026 – AgileMD, Inc., an AI-powered clinical decision support company,[announced today](https://www.wolterskluwer.com/en/news/wolters-kluwer-to-acquire-ai-powered-clinical-decision-support-platform-agilemd) that it has entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by Wolters Kluwer, a global leader in professional information solutions, software and services based in the Netherlands, and the provider of UpToDate. The transaction is subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals.


AgileMD's Clinical Pathways product localizes and operationalizes clinical practice guidelines inside the electronic health record (EHR), giving clinical teams a consistent approach to care. Its eCART product is a real-time,[FDA-cleared clinical surveillance engine](https://www.agilemd.com/updates/ecart-fda-clearance) that continuously assesses hospitalized patients' risk of deterioration and guides teams to escalate care when appropriate. Together these products have been used in the care of over five million patient encounters, by over 220,000 clinicians across more than 500 hospitals, with the impact on clinical outcomes documented in over 80 peer-reviewed publications.


The combination with Wolters Kluwer Health accelerates AgileMD’s reach to thousands of hospitals worldwide and brings together the capabilities of Agile's workflow and analytics functionality with UpToDate's clinical intelligence leadership with Expert AI, extending trusted clinical evidence into localized embedded workflows and new digital health applications.


“We built AgileMD to close the gap between what the evidence says and what happens at the bedside. We want all patients to get high-quality care as a standard—no matter where they are,” said Borna Safabakhsh, AgileMD's CEO and co-founder. “Joining Wolters Kluwer Health lets us do that at a scale we could not reach alone. Coupled with UpToDate, AgileMD can accelerate the development and maintenance of advanced clinical pathways and extend the life-saving scope of eCART.”


The deal is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027 or sooner with Agile retaining its organizational structure inside the larger organization. "Wolters Kluwer is excited to bring over the Agile team, in its entirety, and begin work on enhancing UpToDate AI with Agile’s deep EHR integration and bringing the power of UpToDate to Pathways and eCART," said Yaw Fellin, Senior Vice President, Wolters Kluwer Clinical Solutions. "Combined with UpToDate Expert AI and our partnerships, AgileMD will serve as a vital enabler for true UpToDate ubiquity in healthcare.”


AgileMD, led by co-founders Borna Safabakhsh, MS, MBA, and Dana Peres Edelson, MD, MS, was launched out of the Polsky Center for Entrepreneurship and Innovation at the University of Chicago and is backed by premier startup partners MATTER, Y Combinator, and Rock Health. Houlihan Lokey served as financial advisor to AgileMD on the transaction.


##### About AgileMD


AgileMD is an AI-powered clinical decision support company, founded in 2011 at the University of Chicago with a mission of improving patient outcomes by making evidence-based care universally accessible.
